title: Daalat addat tan gira kaxxiina
intro: Dumaahi baadal kaxxa caylale daala buxak kaxxa gidaaritteh derret, sorkocô baxat faxe amoytiini amri tibba haam duude waa sirri quukah yan num suge. dariifal inkih dirab rabbitte qunun wak, ta rooci dacriseh tibba le amanti cararow addat. too baaxoh abbobti sinnih qibaadah yaamineenih, uxih ta num numma dooreh raacat kee digga amaanak. Asaaku, ku taama, tama agiirinna le rooci miyya kinnim, kay xaagi raqteh tanim, qimmoh addah, qimmoh addah, qimmoh addah, qimmoh addah, qimmoh addah, qimmoh addah, qimmoh addah.
clues: Anu elle mannoowam mango gadda kee qeedaalisso sinni kunnabna, baaxoh amoyti kulliimil qigdu reeda elle yabbixe araca.
yi dariifal yan mari dirab rabbitte qununna wak, anu inni sorkocobaxih addat imaan diifu dacrisa.
Anu geeh adopted awkay yoh baahe qaadah ane sinni gital - ubka hinnay, takkay immay kaxxa daqaarak leeh addat.
Anu inni Rabbih dooqa abeeh, jannatal kay xaqut yan buxa kee yoo marrooweh yan qanxaffek cato essere.
Anu elle barte awki, yi sarrimaane lowsiisak sugeh yan miraacah gexkalit abak yenbeeh, anu inni imaanal digga luk sooleh, meysissot suge way.
Anu Qur'aanak migaq kaak massakaxxa le num kinniyo, anu kaadu Firqawni isih elle sugeh yan aracal suge.

trial.answer: Kaxxa nabiyyi yekkeh yan caben awka geyaanam kee dadlisaanama

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Yallih fayxil gannat addal buxaaxi tomcowwe .
Kaxxa weeqi dumaahi agat kaafir mara bayseh.
Ta baadal kaxxa cayla kee reeda leh tan amoytiini yomcowweh yen
Yalliinu iyya caylale num baddi addat cule
outcome.answer: Yallih fayxil gannat addal buxaaxi tomcowwe .

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
